name: Flow shift (time_snr_shift, ModelSamplingSD3 / AuraFlow)
plain: The shift used by SD3-class flow models. It bends the whole flow time axis so more of it sits at high noise; every schedule read from the model inherits the bend. Shift 1 is no bend. AuraFlow's node is the same code with multiplier 1 (the model's timestep is in 0..1, not 0..1000).
math:
time_snr_shift(α,t) = α·t/(1+(α−1)·t), α=shift, t=timestep/multiplier.
Table: σ_k = time_snr_shift(α, k/1000), k=1..1000. timestep(σ)=σ·multiplier.
Denoised (CONST): x − v·σ. Noise: σ·s·ε + (1−σ)·x0.

props.params: SD3 shift=3.0 multiplier=1000; AuraFlow shift=1.73 multiplier=1

label: from code
surprise: flux_time_shift with σ=1 equals time_snr_shift with α=e^μ, so Flux 'shift' is the log of SD3's shift, and the same number means very different curves (model_sampling.py:292 and :414).
